sentences.text: Ellen Kathleen Pompeo -LRB- -LSB- pʌmˈpɛoʊ -RSB- , born November 10 , 1969 -RRB- is an American actress and producer .
Born in Everett , Massachusetts , Pompeo moved to New York City at 26 where she was discovered by a casting director who signed her for an advertisement campaign for L'Oreal .	L'Oreal	L'Oreal

She made her screen debut with NBC 's legal drama Law & Order , and then guest-starred in other television shows , including the comedy Strangers with Candy , the medical drama Strong Medicine and the sitcom Friends .	NBC	NBC	Law & Order	Law & Order	Strangers with Candy	Strangers with Candy	Strong Medicine	Strong Medicine	Friends	Friends	medical drama	medical drama

Pompeo made her feature film debut in 1999 with the romantic comedy Coming Soon , and went on to play minor roles in films like In the Weeds and Mambo Café but found little success initially .	Coming Soon	Coming Soon (1999 film)

A turning point came in her career in 2002 , when she gained wide recognition for her starring role in Brad Silberling 's drama Moonlight Mile .	Brad Silberling	Brad Silberling	Moonlight Mile	Moonlight Mile (film)

Pompeo then starred in ABC 's popular medical drama Grey 's Anatomy -LRB- 2005 -- present -RRB- , and garnered worldwide recognition for her portrayal of the title character Dr. Meredith Grey .	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	medical drama	medical drama	Meredith Grey	Meredith Grey

The role on the long running series earned her a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress -- Television Series Drama nomination , and the Screen Actors Guild Award .	Screen Actors Guild Award	Screen Actors Guild Award
The character became widely popular , making Pompeo one of the most popular television actresses .

In 2015 , Pompeo was ranked fourth in the list of highest paid TV actresses by Forbes , with the earnings of $ 11.5 million , a spot that she held on to the following year with the earnings of $ 14.5 million .	Forbes	Forbes

Pompeo 's other notable film roles include the comedy Old School -LRB- 2003 -RRB- , the superhero film Daredevil -LRB- 2003 -RRB- , the caper film Art Heist -LRB- 2004 -RRB- , and the comedy drama Life of the Party -LRB- 2005 -RRB- .	Old School	Old School (film)	Daredevil	Daredevil (film)	Art Heist	Art Heist	Life of the Party	Life of the Party (2005 film)

In October 2007 , she was honored with Special Achievement in Entertaining by the National Italian American Foundation for her achievement in the entertainment industry .	National Italian American Foundation	National Italian American Foundation
Pompeo married producer Chris Ivery in 2007 and the couple have three children together .
